title: 第五章 杀你的人来了第六章 埋了
lines: 林昊回到房间，便关闭了房门，迫不及待取出翻天印卷轴。
“翻天印等级虽低，但我的修为也只是开脉，应该最适合我修炼，且看如何。”
林昊双手平伸，打开卷轴。
瞬间，一股古老气息自卷轴内迎面扑来，让林昊身躯一震。
这是古卷，已有岁月痕迹，上刻淡黄色字体，如灵蛇跳跃，最上方几个大字浮现眼帘：一掌翻天，一印覆地，镇压万古！
十二个字，如神钩烙印，磅礴大气。
“这翻天印等级不高，口气却如此大，林家不过是天宝城小家族，即便是祖传战法，又能强到哪里去，我且尝试修炼。”
林昊继续往下看，一段磅礴大气的口诀文字跃然卷轴之上。
乾坤倒悬掌心藏。
万象归墟纳玄黄。
气冲九霄破天罡。
掌覆星河日月殇。
只是几句口诀总纲，便让林昊忍不住热血沸腾。
他一只手拿着卷轴，另一只手按照下方修行之法，真气游走，手掌处顿时闪烁着淡金色光泽。
嗡嗡……
六条至尊神脉跳动起来，澎湃真气涌动。
脑海中竟浮现出一方赤金色大印。
这是他第一次修炼战法，但意念所过出，大印自然成，像是有一个前辈高人，面对面指点一般。
前后仅仅几个呼吸的时间，林昊也只是按照口诀之法运行了一遍，一方赤金色大印，上面闪烁着耀眼的神秘符文，便出现在他掌心。
“成了。”
林昊大喜：“果然是低级战法，如此轻易便修成，只是不知威力如何，回头找人试一试。”
此番场景若是被外人看到，怕是要当场吐血。
战法修行，何等艰难，对于一个开脉境入门修行者来说，即便是最粗浅低级的战法，没个十天半月，初窥门径都难。
而林昊只是看了一遍口诀，战法自成。
只是，卷轴的下半段，却是模糊不清，甚至看不到字体了。
“林家祖传战法，竟只是残卷。”
林昊无语，索性收起卷轴，取出了神行术。
相比较翻天印，林昊更在意神行术，正如林振南所言，遇到危险，逃命的手段尤为重要。
打开神行术的卷轴，上面依旧只有第一重的修行之法，后面是一片空白。
“又是残卷？”
林昊蹙眉：“或许不是残卷，是我修为太弱，等级不够，无法窥探后面的修行法，翻天印和神行术的卷轴上，都带着古老之气，林家非传承世家，族长多半在哄我，翻天印和神行术多半也不是林家祖传，修炼了再说。”
神行术第一重，如影随形！
这门身法，以速度为核心，修炼者可在瞬间爆发出远超常人的移动能力，快如闪电，疾如流星。
普通修士只能看到一道残影，甚至连残影都难以捕捉。
这一夜，林昊不断琢磨翻天印和神行术，一夜过去，林昊意念所致，已然可出现在房间内这片空间的每一处地方。
“好一个神行术，我才修成第一重，便有如此强大的瞬间爆发力，有此身法傍身，即便是遇上气海境修士，也可保命。”
content_en:
Lin Hao returned to the room, closed the door, and couldn't wait to take out the scroll of the Heaven-turning Seal.
"Although the level of the Heaven-turning Seal is low, my cultivation is only to open the meridians. It should be the most suitable for me to practice. Let's see how it goes."
Lin Hao stretched out his hands and opened the scroll.
In an instant, an ancient aura rushed towards him from the scroll, causing Lin Hao's body to tremble.
This is an ancient scroll with traces of time. It is engraved with light yellow fonts, like leaping snakes. The top few characters appear in front of your eyes: One palm overturns the sky, one seal covers the earth, and suppresses the eternal!
Twelve words, like the mark of a divine hook, are majestic and majestic.
"The level of this Heaven-turning Seal is not high, but its tone is so loud. The Lin family is just a small family in Tianbao City. Even if it is an ancestral battle method, how powerful can it be? I will try to practice it."
Lin Hao continued to read down, and a majestic mantra text appeared on the scroll.
The universe hangs upside down and is hidden in the palm of your hand.
All things return to the ruins and accept Xuanhuang.
The anger surged into the sky and shattered the sky.
The palm covers the stars and the sun and the moon.
…………
Just a few general outlines of the formula made Lin Hao's blood boil.
He held the scroll in one hand, and followed the practice method below in the other hand. The true energy moved around, and the palm of his hand suddenly shone with a light golden luster.
Buzzing…
The six supreme divine veins beat, and surging true energy surged.
A large red-gold seal appeared in his mind.
This was his first time practicing fighting techniques, but with his thoughts, the Great Seal formed naturally, as if he had a senior expert giving him face-to-face guidance.
In just a few breaths, Lin Hao just ran the formula once, and a large red-gold seal with dazzling mysterious runes on it appeared in his palm.
"It's done."
Lin Hao was overjoyed: "It is indeed a low-level tactic. It can be mastered so easily. I just don't know how powerful it is. I'll go back and find someone to try it."
If this scene were seen by outsiders, they would probably vomit blood on the spot.
How difficult it is to practice warfare. For an introductory cultivator of the Kaimai Realm, even the most superficial and low-level warfare is difficult to grasp in less than ten days and a half.
But Lin Hao just read the formula once and came up with his own tactics.
However, the second half of the scroll was blurry, and the font could not even be seen.
"The Lin family's ancestral battle techniques are only fragments."
Lin Hao was speechless, simply put away the scroll and took out the magic technique.
Compared with the Heaven-turning Seal, Lin Hao cares more about the magic of magic. As Lin Zhennan said, when encountering danger, the means of escaping is particularly important.
Opening the scroll of divine movement, there is still only the first level of cultivation method on it, and there is a blank space behind it.
"Another scrap?"
Lin Hao frowned: "Perhaps it's not the incomplete scroll, but my cultivation is too weak and my level is not high enough to pry into the practice methods behind it. The scrolls of the Heaven-turning Seal and the Divine Movement Technique all have an ancient air. The Lin family is not an inherited family, and the clan leader is probably coaxing me. The Heaven-turning Seal and the Divine Movement Technique are probably not passed down from the Lin family's ancestors. I will wait until I practice them."
The first level of divine movement, following you everywhere like a shadow!
This movement technique is based on speed. The practitioner can instantly burst into movement abilities far beyond those of ordinary people, as fast as lightning and as fast as a meteor.
Ordinary monks can only see an afterimage, and even the afterimage is difficult to capture.
This night, Lin Hao kept thinking about the Heaven-turning Seal and the Divine Movement Technique. As the night passed, Lin Hao's thoughts could appear everywhere in the space in the room.
"It's such a magical skill. I have just mastered the first level. I have such a powerful instantaneous explosive power. With this skill, I can save my life even if I encounter a Qi Sea Realm monk."
